integrity.computed_checks: 1099 exact host-graph cases; finite checks are not an infinite proof

scientific_limitations: Identifies an unknown labeled host from its population covariance under the specified uniform threshold model; does not address other latent-label laws or unknown thresholds.
Replicates must retain vertex labels, use independent latent weights and the fixed host. No growing-dimensional finite-sample rates are claimed.
Earlier complete-host models and possible implicit broader second-moment treatments leave historical-priority risk.
title: Host-graph reconstruction from degree covariance in vertex-threshold subgraphs
